G	; === IdeaFormer IR3 V2 Belt Printer Start ===\n; Axes: X=lateral, Y=gantry height (probe), Z=belt\nG90 ; absolute positioning\nM82 ; absolute extruder\nG21 ; millimeters\nG28 ; home all axes\nG1 Y20 F500 ; lift nozzle 20mm from belt\n; Bed + hotend temps come from the active filament profile.
